messages:
Alex (CSM): Quick summary from Blueleaf onboarding — three product asks: (1) per-route cost visibility in Console, (2) embedding latency spikes on long queries, (3) tenant-scoped dashboard filters.
Maria (CS): +1. They called out renewal risk if per-route costs stay opaque. Wants a simple export / toggle to hide unused routes.
Sam (PM): Thanks — can you paste the raw notes? Also need to know which of these are quick wins vs deep infra.
Maria (CS): Raw notes:
- "We're seeing 2x variance across routes, can't attribute spend to features"
- "Embeddings around 2k tokens hit ~800ms p99, killing UX for search"
- "Need rollout gates for private deployments & better tenant isolation metrics"
Alex (CSM): Also heard: customer asks for a "delta alert" when a route's cost >30% MoM :eyes: — flagged as renewal concern.
Ade (Eng): Per-route cost visibility needs event tagging + a small analytics job and UI slice. CSV export + label tagging is lowest-effort. Embeddings p99 requires profiling KV cache behavior.
Sam (PM): Proposal: scope MVP as CSV export + route label -> ship next sprint. Tenant filters and alerts in follow-up. Embedding p99 becomes a spike/bugfix track. Anyone object?
Maria (CS): Customer would accept CSV initially — they want something by renewal check-in.
Alex (CSM): I'll mark this renewal-risk and escalate docs for AMs. @Sam (PM) @Ade (Eng) — want me to open a GH issue with acceptance criteria and customer quotes?
Sam (PM): Yes please. Include: customer quote, proposed MVP, acceptance criteria (CSV format, fields, sample export), and renewal timeline. Add labels: cs-feedback, renewal-risk.
deploy-bot: Issue template created by Alex (CSM) — high-priority flag set :rotating_light:
Maria (CS): Also requesting an enablement one-pager for AMs and a short checklist for onboarding.
Sam (PM): Add docs as 'docs' subtask in the issue.
Alex (CSM): Done — GH link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/product/issues/1234 (labels: cs-feedback, renewal-risk, needs-groom).
Ade (Eng): I'll take the CSV & label work next sprint. Will open a spike PR for embedding p99 analysis and share perf logs.
Alex (CSM): Great — I'll schedule a 15m sync with Blueleaf next Tue to confirm acceptance criteria before we start dev.
Maria (CS): Please include AMs on the call.
Sam (PM): Thanks team. We'll triage in next grooming session and confirm priority.
Alex (CSM): Closing the thread here — will update when GH moves to in-progress.
